episode.title: The Medieval Town Of Dunwich Fell Into The Sea

synopsis: An entire medieval English port town, Dunwich, slowly fell into the sea due to severe coastal erosion.

title_card.title: A medieval town fell into the sea.
title_card.subtitle: Coastal erosion slowly submerged Dunwich.

caption:
An entire medieval English port town, Dunwich, slowly fell into the sea.

Dunwich was once a thriving, prosperous English port city with massive churches and bustling harbour docks. Beginning with a catastrophic storm surge in 1286, centuries of relentless coastal erosion gradually eroded the soft sandy cliffs, dragging entire streets and churchyards into the ocean.

Visuals created with AI.

Have you ever seen places where nature completely reclaimed human settlements?
